## 1. Executive Summary

Kirill Lebedev, PhD leads engineering organizations that bridge foundational computer science with large-scale commercial impact. At LinkedIn, as Director of Engineering leading Ads Measurement, he directs a 40–70+ person full-stack organization across Audience, Identity, Incrementality, Recommendations, and Measurement charters. 

He built LinkedIn's Brand Advertising business from the ground up to over $1 billion in annual revenue (~20% of total ad revenue) and led engineering for LinkedIn's AI advertising suite (LinkedIn Accelerate), scaling it 6x to $100M ARR in six months. 

He holds a PhD in Computer Science, graduated summa cum laude with a master's in systems engineering (GPA 5.0 / 5.0), served as an associate professor and deputy vice-rector, and holds three issued U.S. patents.

## 3. Engineering Doctrine & Technical Principles

### Principle 01: Bayesian Causal Inference & Account-Based Marketing
> "Heuristic last-touch models misallocate significant capital toward organic converters. In our systems, we isolate selection bias from true ad intervention using Bayesian incrementality and company-level audience splits."

In advertising, correlation is not causation. If an advertiser was going to buy anyway, claiming attribution for that conversion is an illusion. Dr. Lebedev architected LinkedIn's incrementality systems to measure true economic causality across 25% of total advertising revenue. By deploying Bayesian modeling, company-level audience splitting, and frequency-aware sampling, the platform measures genuine incremental impact for enterprise advertisers with rigorous statistical confidence.

### Principle 02: Differential Privacy & Privacy-Safe Signal Consolidation
> "In advertising, as in physics: if your measurement instruments distort what they observe, your conclusions are worthless. We extract signal from noise while preserving mathematical privacy."

Regulatory and platform privacy shifts require robust cross-entity analytics without exposing raw personal data. Dr. Lebedev directed the comprehensive overhaul of LinkedIn's outcomes infrastructure, unifying Conversions API (CAPI) with privacy-preserving cryptographic computation and differential privacy techniques on a next-generation attribution platform. The systems enforce strict mathematical privacy guarantees while preserving the statistical utility of conversion signals.

### Principle 03: Scaled Identity Graph & Pairwise Multi-Source Resolution
> "An advertising platform is only as coherent as its understanding of identity. By resolving fragmented signals into a unified graph, you turn disconnected events into actionable enterprise intelligence."

Modern measurement and targeting collapse when identity is fractured across devices, browsers, and enterprise ecosystems. Dr. Lebedev directed the architecture of LinkedIn's identity graph infrastructure that ingests and resolves pairwise observations from both first-party platform signals and third-party data providers at scale. By reconciling deterministic and probabilistic link graphs within privacy-safe enclaves, the platform establishes high-fidelity entity resolution that powers accurate audience targeting, frequency governance, and robust causal attribution across the entire monetization ecosystem.

## 5. Issued United States Patents

### US 11,968,185: On-Device Experimentation
- Grant Date: April 23, 2024
- Inventors: Kirill Lebedev et al.
- Official Link: https://patents.google.com/patent/US11968185
- Abstract: A system and method for on-device experimentation allowing mobile and client devices to locally execute randomized treatment assignments, collect telemetry in cryptographic buffers, and perform privacy-preserving statistical inference directly on-device without server round-trips.

### US 11,232,254: Editing Mechanism for Electronic Content Items
- Grant Date: January 25, 2022
- Inventors: Kirill Lebedev et al.
- Official Link: https://patents.google.com/patent/US11232254
- Abstract: An algorithmic framework for dynamic multi-variant digital content composition and runtime structural validation, enabling dynamic layout adaptation and cryptographic content integrity across distributed surfaces.

### US 11,102,534: Content Item Similarity Detection
- Grant Date: August 24, 2021
- Inventors: Kirill Lebedev et al.
- Official Link: https://patents.google.com/patent/US11102534
- Abstract: A scalable similarity detection system using locality-sensitive hashing and high-dimensional vector embeddings capable of sub-millisecond similarity matching for automated content review and duplicate creative suppression at enterprise scale.
